name: House labels
summary: A label war for the shared apartment: its things drawn on a wall (shower, rice cooker, aux, alarm clock); pick a thing, punch a label in your own words and the tape strip flies over and sticks, anyone can relabel anything and only the author can peel theirs.
useWhen: someone needs to put a sign on the shower
someone put a sign on the shower about will
house rules but make it funny
label the house stuff, will can read
passive aggressive labels for the dorm stuff
dontUseWhen: who owns what in the fridge, mapped by shelf (use fridge-map)
chores and who does them (use chore-wheel)
quiet hours or real house rules (use quiet-hours-dm)

kind.description: Drawing: fridge, cooker, shower, speaker, clock, binder, plant or door

label.description: The label already on it, up to 24 characters, or omitted
